changes_made.explanation: Consolidated datasets to avoid redundancy, removed datasets only mentioned in exclusion (Paracrawl), normalized model naming, and added description of back-translation outputs which are central to the paper's methodology.
No changes needed - BLEU is correctly identified as the only automatic metric used, with sacreBLEU implementation mentioned but not a distinct metric.
No LLMs were used as judges in this 2020 paper - the methodology predates widespread use of LLM evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted - the paper relies exclusively on automatic BLEU scoring.

overall_notes: This is a well-focused machine translation paper studying back-translation techniques. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy in dataset naming. The paper exclusively uses BLEU for evaluation and focuses on Transformer-based NMT systems. No human or LLM evaluation was conducted.
